WEREWOLF COMPLETE FIRST PASS: 20 paid skills, 100 one-point ranks, true native JAWR wolf form ownership and health regeneration; fifth Moon Apex branch passive and moon-specific. Design-only.
VAMPIRE COMPLETED DESIGN: 19 paid skills in five branches 25/20/20/20/15, 100 one-point ranks; JAWR native blood, sunlight, BAT and feeding remain free. Source-only design.

All ranks per one character cost one point; past Sea Dragon 50-point Luck reservation and 40 unallocated status are superseded. No historic rank distribution or source numeric effect automatically becomes a live cap.
SEA DRAGON FIRST PASS COMPLETE: 22 meaningful paid skills, 100 one-point ranks, 10 total Sea Dragon Luck ranks. Complete Sea-specific design under stacked PR, not active runtime.

Owner's newer balance-pass intent supersedes historical per-node weightings, previous target cap assertions and generator-reserved 50-point Luck allocation. Older catalogs are provenance only unless reconfirmed.

OWNER RULE: every purchasable rank costs exactly ONE advancement point, with no escalating rank price and no expensive one-rank capstone. Every complete eligible non-Monk tree build has exactly 100 purchasable ranks and thus 100 total points.

OWNER RULE: the 100 points cap describes a fully mastered single character, not the total of mutually exclusive visible alternatives. Hunter is 62 common + one 8-point training style + one 30-point favored-prey specialty.

Reduced total mastery cost from legacy ~300-500 SP is the source of increased potency per point. Do NOT shrink rank counts while keeping purchase price if doing so would charge more than one point per rank.
Early native abilities, species states, Fury mechanics, Gilded base Fortune/Looting, and Hunter free specialty selections remain free and separate. Never relicense or reprice without owner review.
Core is universal and independent of Newbie/Normie/Path identity; it is not a fifth dragon path or additional class.
Costs for every possible Hunter specialty cannot be summed as a playable 100-point build; the 498-point visible alternative catalog is intentionally greater than 100.
